name: Mental Breakdown Beaverton 2020

venue.name: University of Portland Pamplin School of Business at Bethany Village
venue.details: Parking is behind the building. Enter the hallway in the top floor, the venue will be at the end of the hallway.

information:
#The competition is cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. 

**Join our facebook group to hear about competitions in the Pacific Northwest before they're announced and keep in touch with cubers in the area!**

[![Image description](http://i.imgur.com/8uf2SCt.png)](https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085/)

The main event of this competition is 3x3x3 blindfolded
